canonical_name: Privileged Remote Access Not Separately Authenticated
description: Privileged commands executed via remote access are not authenticated separately from initial session authentication. This signal indicates that elevated privileges may be exercised without additional verification.
applicability: Applicable to all privileged remote access scenarios. Includes remote administrative sessions, privileged access management systems, and any remote elevation of privileges.

metadata.detection_notes: Detected through remote access authentication flow review, privileged session management assessment, and step-up authentication verification.

sources.title: 32 CFR Part 170 - Cybersecurity Maturity Model Certification Program
